findings.title: AHPRA suspension notices expose an employee's regulatory status to region administrators outside their assigned pharmacies.
findings.scenario: Sara works at Tom's pharmacy and her AHPRA registration is suspended. Grace is a region administrator in the same organisation but assigned only to Nadia's different pharmacy. The suspension notifier delivers Sara's name, pharmacy affiliation and registration status to Grace despite her lacking permission to manage Tom's pharmacy.
findings.test_needed: Create two pharmacies in one organisation; Sara is at A, Grace REGION_ADMIN assigned only B. Trigger Sara AHPRA suspension and assert Grace receives no in-app/email status, while authorized A managers do.

owner_question.question: Should region administrator Grace receive Sara's AHPRA suspension details when Sara works at a pharmacy Grace cannot manage?
options: No; deliver only to managers scoped to Sara's pharmacy
Send a generic staffing alert without identity or regulatory detail
Yes; all regional administrators in the organisation receive detailed suspension notices
